discovery.title: Meta says its new AI accounts have passed 10 million—what draws people in?
discovery.summary: Meta reported third-quarter revenue above estimates and said its Muse AI accounts had topped 10 million. The company also disclosed a large one-time charge tied to an agreement.
discovery.why_it_matters: A fast-growing feature can change how people use social platforms—and what kinds of content, privacy choices and business models platforms prioritize.

discovery.title: In hot-weather tournaments, changing the clock may help more than changing the date
discovery.summary: A study roundup reports that adjusting tournament playing hours may increase access to lower-risk conditions more effectively than changing event dates, using environmental heat measurements to assess schedules.
discovery.why_it_matters: Scheduling choices can affect athlete safety, competition fairness and event logistics as heat changes the usable hours of a day.

sources.title: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
